blocks.text: Local food entrepreneurs take center stage as the Foodtok Food Fair brings a flavorful showcase of homegrown food products to SM City Cebu, giving shoppers a chance to discover local MSMEs while supporting the businesses behind their favorite treats. Happening at the Lower Ground Level – Main Mall, the food fair gathers local entrepreneurs in Cebu’s most-loved mall, creating a convenient destination for shoppers to explore baked treats, pastries, sweets, waffles, and other local food finds. Beyond satisfying cravings, Foodtok provides MSMEs with an opportunity to bring their products closer to a wider market, introduce their brands to new customers, and […]...
